findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_reconciliation, get_provenance · Private data: search_datasets, get_dataset, get_data_passport, find_stale, find_anomalies, find_deteriorating, find_recovering, find_unreliable, find_schema_drift, check_reconciliation, get_provenance, get_evidence, verify_dataset, get_freshness_summary, verify_evidence, trust_verdict, verify_attestation, find_by_licence, usage_summary · Public sink: find_anomalies, find_recovering, find_unreliable, get_provenance · Destructive: verify_attestation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_reconciliation, get_provenance · Private data: search_datasets, get_dataset, get_data_passport, find_stale, find_anomalies, find_deteriorating, find_recovering, find_unreliable, find_schema_drift, check_reconciliation, get_provenance, get_evidence, verify_dataset, get_freshness_summary, verify_evidence, trust_verdict, verify_attestation, find_by_licence, usage_summary · Public sink: find_anomalies, find_recovering, find_unreliable, get_provenance · Destructive: verify_attestation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
